title: On Releasing the birds before the fair
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：release　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 release 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the herder ① released the birds before the fair at once, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the herder ② releases the birds before the fair in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ release the birds before the fair at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ released the birds before the fair before — a line in the ledger for December 1947 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Releasing the birds before the fair at once, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ release the accounts at the year end in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Release the accounts at the year end at once and never mention it again.

By 1960 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new neighbour from the next pasture ⑧ releases the accounts at the year end at once every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ released the birds before the fair again when nobody else would.

⑩ To release the birds before the fair, my mother said in 1965, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, somebody releases the birds before the fair in the rain again and somebody must release the birds before the fair at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 释放（一般过去式 released the birds before the fair：1953 年牧人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 释放（一般现在 releases the birds before the fair：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 释放（不定式 to release the birds before the fair：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 释放（过去完成时 had released the birds before the fair：1947 年十二月的牧群台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 释放（动名词 releasing the birds before the fair 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 发布（release the accounts at the year end：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去发布年底公布了那些账目）
G. v. 发布（release the accounts at the year end：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 释放（后段两处：新来的邻人照例 releases the accounts at the year end，而母亲又一次 released the birds before the fair）

release 意为“发布”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去发布年底公布了那些账目”，should ever 之后用原形 release the accounts at the year end。

release 意为“释放”，结尾那句是母亲 1965 年的话：要释放集市前把那些鸟放走，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和牧场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 release 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the herder released the birds before the fair at once, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the herder releases the birds before the fair in the rain whenever the pasture asks.
Releasing the birds before the fair at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever release the accounts at the year end in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next pasture releases the accounts at the year end at once every winter, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother released the birds before the fair again, and the pasture remembered that half.
